description: Hand-maintained catalog behind the Hub KIT page. Registered component names and mock scenarios are re-derived from templates/webview/apc-ui/*.js on every request; everything else (docs, demo scenes, coverage) lives here. test/hub-kit.test.js fails when the two disagree. The visual spec of every element (parts, states, sizes, tokens) lives in design_library/apc-minimal/design-system.json "elements". How to extend: .agents/guides/hub-kit.md

scenarioNotes.demo: Unlicensed: footer shows [DEMO]; gated verbs open the activation sheet.
scenarioNotes.unverified: License file present but not verified: [UNVERIFIED] + explanation.
scenarioNotes.update-available: Update 1.3.0 available with release notes; footer shows the update note.
scenarioNotes.update-failed: First download fails at 40 percent, the retry succeeds.
scenarioNotes.io-error: Every persisting call returns {error:"io", path}: shows the never-fail-silently toasts.

components.name: knob
components.title: Knob
components.summary: Rotary control: vertical drag, SVG ring with modulation arcs, readout under the dial, value entry on click. Reads its ParamDescriptor from the bridge.

options.name: data-param
options.desc: Immutable parameter ID (X-01). The descriptor comes from apc.params.get.

options.name: data-label
options.desc: Visible label and accessible name (default: existing text, else descriptor name).

options.name: data-readout
options.desc: Readout position (below by default); "false" still hides it.

options.name: data-bipolar
options.desc: Value arc starts at the centre (automatic when min < 0 < max).

options.name: data-size
options.desc: Knob diameter: sm 2rem | md 3rem | lg 4rem | a CSS length | a bare number = rem (default --knob-size).

options.name: data-unit
options.desc: Unit style: inline "1.2 kHz" (default), a dimmed separate span, or none (aria keeps the unit).

options.name: data-ticks
options.desc: 5 = five ticks incl. both ends; steps = one per step of a stepped / choice parameter.

options.name: data-disabled
options.desc: No interaction, aria-disabled, out of the tab order; el.__apcCtl.setDisabled(bool) at runtime.

events.name: ctl:drag
events.note: gesture start/end; the tooltip uses it

events.name: undo:push
events.note: module optional; nobody listening is fine

events.name: params:changed
events.note: refetch the descriptor (after modulation / MIDI edits)

demo.hint: CUTOFF is modulated (ring + arcs) and MIDI-learned. Try drag, Shift+drag, Alt+click, double-click, click the readout, right-click.

options.desc: JSON curve specs: {fn|points|x,y|values, color, width, fill, dash, label}.

options.name: data-connect
options.desc: Draw a line through the nodes.

options.name: data-viz
options.desc: Feed id of a curve pushed by the host.

events.name: graph:node (bus)
events.payload: {id, node, x, y, q, phase: begin|move|end|wheel|key|reset, text}

events.name: viz (bridge)
events.note: native name apc.viz; data shape per element; emit ~30 fps from analysis, not per audio buffer

events.name: param (bridge)
events.note: bound node params follow the host

gestures.action: moves x/y (Shift = 10x finer); one begin ... end gesture per drag
tooltip with the values and guides

demo.hint: Node 1 is bound to cutoff_hz / gain_db (mock params); 2 and 3 are free. Drag, Shift+drag, wheel for Q, Alt+click, or focus a node and use the arrows. Curves are display only.

components.name: envelope
components.title: Envelope
components.summary: ADSR or free N-point envelope editor on the graph engine; ADSR nodes bind to attack, decay, sustain and release parameters (unbound ids keep local values).

options.name: data-xscale
options.desc: sqrt for adsr (short times stay editable); linear for multi.

events.name: param (bridge)
events.note: bound ADSR parameters follow the host

gestures.action: edits time / level; attack + decay + hold + release stay within tmax
add a point; Insert adds one after the focused point
remove a free point (>= 2 stay) / reset

demo.hint: Left: ADSR bound to attack_s / release_s (decay and sustain are local). Right: free multi-point envelope: double-click to add a point, Delete removes it.

components.name: spectrum
components.title: Spectrum
components.summary: Live spectrum analyser (fill, line or bars) fed by the viz event; log or linear frequency axis, peak hold and frame-rate independent smoothing. Display only.

options.name: data-viz
options.desc: Feed id ({type:"spectrum", db:[...], fs, log?} or a bare dB array).

events.name: viz (bridge)
events.note: native name apc.viz; data shape per element; emit ~30 fps from analysis, not per audio buffer

gestures.action: no pointer or keyboard interaction; a text alternative names the strongest component (once per second)

demo.hint: Fed by apc-mock-viz.js (demo only; a real plugin pushes the same {type:"spectrum"} payloads from native).

components.name: waveform
components.title: Waveform
components.summary: Waveform display: static peaks of a sample, a scrolling roll, or an oscilloscope trace; one min/max column per device pixel. Display only.

options.name: data-viz
options.desc: Feed id ({type:"waveform", min:[..], max:[..]} peak columns or {samples:[..]}).

events.name: viz (bridge)
events.note: native name apc.viz; data shape per element; emit ~30 fps from analysis, not per audio buffer

gestures.action: no interaction; API: setSamples, setPeaks, pushPeaks, pushSamples, clear, setCursor(0..1) draws an accent playhead

demo.hint: Top: a static sample (data-samples). Bottom: scrolling peak columns fed by the demo mock.

components.name: scope
components.title: Scope
components.summary: Oscilloscope trace with an optional rising-zero-crossing trigger (the waveform element in scope mode). Display only.

options.name: data-viz
options.desc: Feed id ({type:"waveform", min:[..], max:[..]} peak columns or {samples:[..]}).

events.name: viz (bridge)
events.note: native name apc.viz; data shape per element; emit ~30 fps from analysis, not per audio buffer

gestures.action: no interaction; each frame replaces the trace
the mock emits one static frame

demo.hint: Fed by apc-mock-viz.js frames of 512 samples; with the trigger on, the trace is stable.

components.name: meter
components.title: Meter
components.summary: Level meter (1 or 2 channels, continuous or segmented) with peak hold, a latching clip lamp, warn/clip zones and dB ticks. Value convention: linear amplitude by default, dB with data-input="db".

options.name: data-meter
options.desc: Feed id: bridge event meter {id,value} (also data-viz / the element id).

options.name: data-meter-r
options.desc: Second id for the right channel.

events.name: meter (bridge)
events.note: linear amplitude, or dB with data-input="db"

events.name: viz (bridge)
events.note: native name apc.viz; data shape per element; emit ~30 fps from analysis, not per audio buffer

gestures.input: Click the clip lamp / Enter / Space
gestures.action: reset the clip latch (a real button)
instant attack, linear fall (data-fall); clip latches until reset
role=meter with aria-valuetext "L -12.3 dB, R -14.0 dB, clipped" (max 4x/s)

demo.hint: Fed by apc-mock-viz.js; it touches 0 dB now and then, which latches the clip lamp (click it to reset).

components.name: stepseq
components.title: Step sequencer
components.summary: Step grid (gate, value or pitch mode) with accents, beat grouping, a playhead and row labels; paint with the pointer or edit by keyboard. Array parameters are supported via the bridge.

options.name: data-steps
options.desc: JSON: gate = rows x count of 0|1|2 (2 = accent); value = count numbers; pitch = count rows from the bottom, -1 = rest.

options.name: data-param
options.desc: Bridge parameter; used only when its descriptor is an array parameter ({array:true}, type/kind "steps" or an array value).

options.name: data-viz
options.desc: Playhead feed id ({type:"playhead", step} | {type:"steps", steps, accents?}).

events.name: stepseq (bus)
events.payload: {id, mode, steps, accents?, length, count, phase: change|end|key|api|length|clear}

events.name: viz (bridge)
events.note: native name apc.viz; data shape per element; emit ~30 fps from analysis, not per audio buffer

gestures.action: paint steps (starting on a lit cell erases)
set the value from the pointer height (Shift unquantised, Alt clears)
select the row; click again = rest
move (value mode: Up/Down edit; pitch: Up/Down change pitch)

demo.hint: Click and drag to paint; Shift+click accents; arrows + Space for the keyboard. The playhead comes from the demo mock (120 bpm 16ths).

components.name: xypad
components.title: XY pad
components.summary: Two-axis pad bound to two parameters: absolute press-and-drag, Shift for relative fine control, a tick marks the defaults.

options.name: data-x
options.desc: X parameter id (unbound = local 0..1, or data-xmin / data-xmax).

events.name: xypad:change (bus)
events.payload: {id, x, y, nx, ny, phase: begin|move|end|key|reset}

gestures.action: jump to the pointer and follow (one begin ... end gesture)

demo.hint: The left pad drives the mock parameters cutoff_hz / resonance_pct; the right one is free (local 0..1). Drag, Shift for fine, double-click resets.

components.name: picture
components.title: Picture
components.summary: Image or artwork slot (relative path or data URI only, never the network) with a token-coloured test-image placeholder and an optional spectrum overlay.

options.name: data-alt
options.desc: MANDATORY accessible text (data-alt="" = decorative). Missing: a warning toast.

options.name: data-src
options.desc: Relative path or data:image/... only; http(s), file:, javascript: are rejected with a visible error block.

events.name: error (bus)
events.note: rejected URL or failed load; shown as a toast

gestures.action: role=img with aria-label = alt; setSrc(url) / setFit(f) at runtime

demo.hint: No src: a procedurally drawn stand-in (labelled TEST IMAGE). The right one overlays a live spectrum (demo mock feed).

components.name: context-panel
components.title: Context panel
components.summary: Not a data-apc component: every control opens it on right-click / Shift+F10 / the "..." button. Sections in order VALUE -> MODULATION -> MIDI -> HELP. Programmatic: APC.context. Offered sources: APC.context.sources.
components.markup:
// nothing to mount - it belongs to the controls:
APC.context.sources = [{ id: "lfo1", name: "LFO 1" }, { id: "macro1", name: "Macro 1" }];

options.name: APC.context.sources
options.desc: Array of {id, name} offered in "+ Add source" (default LFO 1/2, Env 1/2, Macro 1, Velocity, Keytrack, Mod Wheel, Aftertouch, Random, Breath, Expression).

demo.hint: Opened automatically on CUTOFF (2 modulation routes, MIDI CC 74). Esc closes it.

components.name: infobar
components.title: Info bar
components.summary: One-line help text: hovering or focusing a control shows [Name] value (default x) - what effect ...; idle shows the preset name and * when dirty. The footer embeds one automatically.

events.name: prefs:changed
events.note: ui.tooltips = false disables the hover text

demo.hint: Hover or Tab onto a knob: the bar shows the parameter help text (written once in the descriptor).

components.name: help-button
components.title: Help button
components.summary: Visible Help button (X-09: F1 and ? are often swallowed by the host). Toggles help mode: click any control to open its manual entry without changing it. The header embeds one by default.

demo.hint: Click Help, then click a knob: its manual entry opens. Esc leaves help mode.

components.name: header
components.title: Header
components.summary: Brand lockup (logo -> company URL, name -> product URL, only when configured in apc.info.links), a Save slot, the Help button, the theme switch, the scale control and the settings gear. Links go through apc.openUrl on click, never automatically.
components.markup:
<header class="apc-cell" data-apc="header" data-product="Example Synth" data-manufacturer="Example Audio"
        style="left:0;top:0;width:50rem;height:2.5rem"></header>

options.name: data-logo-src
options.desc: Image used instead of the manufacturer text.

options.name: data-save
options.desc: Render a plain Save button in the Save slot (emits preset:save); otherwise the slot is left for the presets module.

demo.body: <header class="apc-cell" style="left:0rem;top:0rem;width:50rem;height:2.5rem" data-apc="header" data-product="Example Synth" data-manufacturer="Example Audio" data-save="true"></header>
demo.hint: Brand parts become links only because the mock configures info.links.company / product. Click a link: it goes through apc.openUrl (mock records it, nothing opens).

components.name: footer
components.title: Footer
components.summary: Version v<semver> is ALWAYS visible (U-16, never only in a menu). Shares the spot with the [DEMO] / [TRIAL n d] badge and the "update available" note; hosts an info bar showing the preset name and dirty *. Switch the scenario to see each state.

options.name: data-version
options.desc: Version text shown synchronously before apc.info resolves.

events.name: update:open
events.note: update note click (the update dialog listens)

demo.body: <footer class="apc-cell" style="left:0rem;top:3.5rem;width:50rem;height:2rem" data-apc="footer" data-version="1.2.0"></footer>
demo.hint: Pick scenario demo / trial / update-available to see the badge and the update note beside the version.

components.name: scale
components.title: Scale control
components.summary: The +/- scale control: 50..300 % in 25 % steps through one scale pipeline (APC.chrome.scale). The header embeds one by default.

demo.hint: Click + / - and watch the percentage. The Hub iframe scale selector is separate: it resizes the window, the control resizes the plugin.

components.name: gripper
components.title: Gripper
components.summary: Bottom-right corner gripper: aspect-locked drag, snaps to 5 %, forwards raw deltas to the native resizeGrip functions (no-op outside JUCE) and calls apc.ui.setScale on release. Also a keyboard slider.

demo.hint: Drag the corner: outside JUCE the native resize is a no-op, so only the scale value changes.

components.name: theme-switch
components.title: Theme switch
components.summary: Night / Day / Follow-OS button (U-07, optional per product: hidden unless features.themeEnabled). Sets data-theme="night|day" on <html>. A design supplies its own [data-theme] token blocks; the kit ships fallback sets.

demo.hint: Click to cycle Follow OS -> Night -> Day. The viewport selector in the Hub only sets the starting mode.

components.name: settings
components.title: Settings overlay
components.summary: Overlay (not an OS dialog) with tabs Global, Engine / Quality, MIDI, Presets & Data, License, About (U-05). Changes are written immediately as a minimal patch; a failed write shows an inline error plus a toast and the control snaps back. Engine edits stay per instance (X-08).

options.name: (none)
options.desc: Opens on click / Enter. APC.emit("settings:open", {tab}) or APC.settingsUI.open({tab}). Esc closes, focus is trapped and restored.

events.name: settings:open
events.note: tab: global | engine | midi | presets | license | about

demo.body: <button class="apc-btn" data-apc="settings" aria-label="Settings" style="position:absolute;left:1rem;top:1rem">⚙ Settings</button>
demo.hint: Opened automatically. Switch tabs; most changes write at once (see the mock call log via APC.mock.calls in the console).

components.name: presets
components.title: Preset browser
components.summary: Full browser: scope, filters (OR within a group, AND across), search, true sorting, ratings, favorites, dirty *, Revert, Init, A/B with copy, Save / Save As, Import / Export. Native does the filtering and sorting; every I/O error is a visible toast naming the path. Needs a definite height.

events.name: license:open
events.note: a gated verb (Save As, Import, Export) returned {error:"gated"}

events.name: preset (bridge)
events.note: current preset / dirty / A-B changed natively

demo.hint: Scenario demo: Save As / Import / Export open the activation sheet (gated). Scenario io-error: save failures name the failing path in a toast.

components.name: preset-chip
components.title: Preset chip
components.summary: Compact header chip: previous / next, preset name with dirty *, a visible Save button (Ctrl/Cmd+S is only an accelerator, X-09). Clicking the name opens the browser as a modal sheet.

events.name: license:open
events.note: a gated verb (Save As, Import, Export) returned {error:"gated"}

events.name: preset (bridge)
events.note: current preset / dirty / A-B changed natively

demo.hint: Click the name to open the browser sheet; Save is a real button.

components.name: license
components.title: License
components.summary: Inline license status plus the activation sheet. Badge text DEMO, TRIAL n d, LICENSED to <name>, UNVERIFIED with a plain-language explanation. Modes: none (renders nothing), signed-file (Load File only), online-activation (serial + e-mail, Load File, offline method B, Deactivate). Never blocks audio; the sheet always has Later / Esc. Fake serials: TEST-0000-... activates, FULL-... = seat limit.

options.name: data-drop-target
options.desc: Accept a dropped .lic file anywhere in the document while the sheet is open.

events.name: license:open
events.note: footer badge and every gated verb emit it

demo.hint: The activation sheet opens as if a gated verb (PresetSave) had been refused. Try serial TEST-0000-ABCD with any e-mail.

components.name: update
components.title: Update
components.summary: Update panel and sheet following Idle -> Checking -> UpToDate | UpdateAvailable -> Downloading (progress, Cancel) -> Verifying -> ReadyToInstall ("Close your DAW, then run this installer.") | Failed (visible error + Try again). Never claims it installs by itself and never downloads without a click.

events.name: update (bridge)
events.note: contract wrapper or the bare state object

demo.hint: Scenario update-available: press Download and watch the state machine. update-failed: the first download fails at 40 percent, the retry succeeds.

coverage.item: Alt/Option+click resets to the declared default (base value only)
Double-click resets (switchable to value entry)
Click on the value readout opens numeric entry (Enter / Esc, locale-aware, clamped with feedback)
Shift+drag fine adjust (Ctrl super-fine)
Right-click context panel: value, modulation, MIDI, help
Modulated controls show one summed ring, live position and marker
Wheel nudges; scrollable panels follow the wheel-target rule
Version string always visible (v<semver> + demo / trial badge + update note)
Bottom-right corner gripper, rounds to 5 %
Scale steps 50..300 % (- / + control)
Aspect lock on by default
Scale persisted machine-wide, clamped to fit at startup; DPR handled separately
coverage.note: the kit calls apc.ui.setScale; persistence and the startup clamp are native

coverage.item: Settings overlay Global | Engine/Quality | MIDI | Presets & Data | License | About
Theme Night / Day / Follow-OS
coverage.note: both modes must also pass the contrast rules: run apc validate a11y on the real design

coverage.item: Tooltip toggle + delay (400 ms), never during drag, fixed anchor / info bar, F1 help mode
Preset load behavior: Instant / Confirm if dirty
Open Presets Folder + Rescan + Restore defaults
Global settings are machine-wide, applied on window open, merged safely
coverage.note: the UI sends a minimal patch; lock + merge is the native settings store

coverage.item: Engine / Quality lives in the DAW chunk; the machine value only seeds new instances
Help and quick-save reachable by visible buttons (F1, ? and Ctrl/Cmd+S only accelerate)
Dirty * indicator + Revert to saved
A/B compare with Copy A -> B
Every preset I/O operation reports success or a visible error (never fail silently)
Declared default per parameter (enables reset + migration)
coverage.note: the descriptor supplies the default; the native parameter table must declare it

coverage.item: Header lockup: logo -> company URL, name -> product URL, only if configured
About: version, build date, links, legal; manual Check for Updates always present
No auto-launch, no embedded ads, fully offline-capable
coverage.note: links open only through apc.openUrl on a click; the native allow-list is outside the kit

coverage.item: Demo gating shown honestly: gated verbs open the activation sheet, never block audio
coverage.note: enforcement itself is native (the UI only reflects apc.license.status)

coverage.item: Undo / redo stack (>= 32 steps)
coverage.note: the kit only emits undo:push; there is no undo stack component

coverage.item: Full MIDI Learn table (CC assignment, ranges, export / import)
coverage.note: MIDI tab, shown only when features.midiLearnTable

coverage.item: Drag-and-drop modulation routing, macros
Auto-update check (default off) + update flow ending in ReadyToInstall

coverageSource.summary: Baseline checklist of the locked UX standard pack (decisions U-01..U-16, X-08, X-09, P-xx, L-xx), summarised here because plans/ is gitignored and not read at runtime.

statusLegend.kit: implemented by the kit and covered by a self-test page
statusLegend.partial: kit part implemented; the rest is native / per-product
statusLegend.native: native or build-side responsibility, not a kit component
statusLegend.not-in-kit: opt-in module the kit does not provide yet
